'''Ace''' was the leader of the [[Afterburners]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. He kept an eye on the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Phoggus Maxx]].<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
